examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

examples.chinese: 這個房子又大又舒服，房租只要三千塊，真是太便宜了！
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi yòu dà yòu shūfu, fángzū zhǐyào sānqiān kuài, zhēn shì tài piányi le!
examples.english: This house is both big and comfortable, and the rent is only 3,000 dollars—it's really too cheap!

examples.chinese:
付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。
他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin:
Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán.
Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english:
When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk.
He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 小李第一次參加釣魚比賽就得了第一名，真是幸運。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ dì-yī cì cānjiā diàoyú bǐsài jiù dé le dì-yī míng, zhēn shì xìngyùn.
examples.english: Little Li got first place the first time he participated in a fishing competition; he is really lucky.

examples.chinese:
你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。
下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。
昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le.
Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé.
Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends.
After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam.
Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

examples.chinese: 他大哥跟大嫂是同年同月同日生的，真是太巧了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàgē gēn dàsǎo shì tóng nián tóng yuè tóng rì shēng de, zhēn shì tài qiǎo le.
examples.english: His eldest brother and eldest sister-in-law were born on the same year, same month, and same day—it's really such a coincidence.

examples.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
examples.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 他們在露營活動中現學現唱了八首歌，真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lùyíng huódòng zhōng xiàn xué xiàn chàng le bā shǒu gē, zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: At the camping activity, they learned and sang eight songs on the spot; that's really amazing.

examples.chinese: 我坐在公園裡看著花兒隨著風搖擺，那個樣子真是可愛極了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài gōngyuán lǐ kànzhe huār suízhe fēng yáobǎi, nàge yàngzi zhēnshi kě'ài jí le.
examples.english: I sat in the park watching the flowers sway with the wind; that appearance was really extremely cute.

examples.chinese: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dào le tèbié de jiérì, Zhāng xiānsheng jiù huì sòng xiānhuā gěi tàitai, zhēn shì làngmàn.
examples.english: Every time a special holiday comes, Mr. Zhang sends fresh flowers to his wife; it's truly romantic.

examples.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
examples.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

examples.chinese: A:哎呀！我的手機掉到河裡了。 （shock or annoyance）B:那真是傷腦筋，看來你只好再買一支了。
examples.pinyin: A: Āiyā! Wǒ de shǒujī diào dào hé lǐ le. B: Nà zhēn shì shāng nǎojīn, kànlái nǐ zhǐhǎo zài mǎi yī zhī le.
examples.english: A: Oh no! My cell phone fell into the river. B: That's really a headache; it seems you'll have to buy another one.

examples.chinese: 電腦展內的人太多了，大家擠來擠去的，真是受不了。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo zhǎn nèi de rén tài duō le, dàjiā jǐ lái jǐ qù de, zhēn shì shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: There are too many people inside the computer exhibition; everyone is crowding in and squeezing around—it's really unbearable.

examples.chinese: 上次你跟我提的事，我一點兒印象都沒有，真是不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì nǐ gēn wǒ tí de shì, wǒ yìdiǎnr yìnxiàng dōu méiyǒu, zhēn shì bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.english: The matter you mentioned to me last time—I don't have the slightest impression of it; I'm really sorry.

examples.chinese: 這場籃球比賽我們贏了對方二十分，真是太痛快了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài wǒmen yíng le duìfāng èrshí fēn, zhēn shì tài tòngkuài le.
examples.english: We won this basketball game against the other team by twenty points—it was really so exhilarating!

examples.chinese: 你正好說出了我的心裡話，真是我的知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhènghǎo shuōchū le wǒ de xīnlihuà, zhēn shì wǒ de zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: You happened to say exactly what's in my heart; you are truly my close friend.

examples.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
examples.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
examples.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

examples.chinese: 黃媽媽感冒那幾天，她女兒每天煮粥給她吃，真是懂事。
examples.pinyin: Huáng māma gǎnmào nà jǐ tiān, tā nǚ'ér měitiān zhǔ zhōu gěi tā chī, zhēn shì dǒngshì.
examples.english: During the days when Mrs. Huang had a cold, her daughter cooked porridge for her every day; she is really sensible.

examples.chinese: 我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì xià ge yuè zǒngsuàn yào hé jiāowǎng shí nián de nǚpéngyǒu jiéhūn le, zhēn shì bù róngyì a!
examples.english: My colleague is finally going to marry his girlfriend of ten years next month—it really wasn't easy!

examples.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
examples.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.

examples.chinese: 我大哥今年三十歲了，我們的年紀差了十歲。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē jīnnián sānshí suì le, wǒmen de niánjì chà le shí suì.
examples.english: My oldest brother is thirty years old this year; there is a ten-year age difference between us.

examples.chinese: 那個老人年紀太大，沒辦法一個人生活。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén niánjì tài dà, méi bànfǎ yīgè rén shēnghuó.
examples.english: That old man is too old; he has no way to live by himself.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩年紀太小，不會自己穿衣服、脫褲子。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái niánjì tài xiǎo, bù huì zìjǐ chuān yīfu, tuō kùzi.
examples.english: That child is too young; he can't put on clothes or take off his pants by himself.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese:
我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。
我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng.
Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english:
My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain.
Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese:
這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。
弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le.
Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english:
I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test.
Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: A:哎，有沒有看見我的錢包？ B:哎，你怎麼又在找東西了呢？ A:哎，年紀大了就是這樣？ B:哎，你還年輕呢！讓我幫你一起找吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Āi, yǒu méiyǒu kànjiàn wǒ de qiánbāo? B: Āi, nǐ zěnme yòu zài zhǎo dōngxi le ne? A: Āi, niánjì dà le jiùshì zhèyàng? B: Āi, nǐ hái niánqīng ne! Ràng wǒ bāng nǐ yīqǐ zhǎo ba.
examples.english: A: Hey, have you seen my wallet? B: Hey, how come you're looking for things again? A: Hey, that's just how it is when you get old, I guess? B: Hey, you're still young! Let me help you look for it together.

examples.chinese: 在公車上，看到年紀大的人應該讓位子請他們坐。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngchē shàng, kàndào niánjì dà de rén yīnggāi ràng wèizi qǐng tāmen zuò.
examples.english: On the bus, when you see elderly people, you should yield your seat and ask them to sit.

examples.chinese: 請你說明一下，這些產品的功能有什麼差別？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng yíxià, zhèxiē chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.english: Please explain, what differences are there in the functions of these products?

examples.chinese: 這兩臺機器樣子相同，但在構造與功能上是有差別的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tái jīqì yàngzi xiāngtóng, dàn zài gòuzào yǔ gōngnéng shàng shì yǒu chābié de.
examples.english: These two machines look the same, but they differ in structure and function.

examples.chinese: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
examples.pinyin: Dāng shìnèi yǔ hùwài wēndù de chābié hěn dà shí, wǒ jiù róngyì gǎnmào.
examples.english: When the difference between indoor and outdoor temperatures is large, I easily catch a cold.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 便利商店不遠，從我家過去只要五分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn bù yuǎn, cóng wǒ jiā guòqù zhǐyào wǔ fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The convenience store is not far; going over from my home takes only five minutes.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese:
每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。
導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin:
Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù.
Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english:
Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing.
The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 如果說能回到過去，我最想放下工作，追求自己的興趣。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒshuō néng huídào guòqù, wǒ zuì xiǎng fàngxià gōngzuò, zhuīqiú zìjǐ de xìngqù.
examples.english: If I could return to the past, I would most want to set aside work and pursue my own interests.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

examples.chinese: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guòqù dào xiànzài, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi yīzhí shì Huárén zuì zhòngshì de chuántǒng guānniàn zhī yī.
examples.english: From the past to the present, respecting elders has always been one of the traditional values that Chinese people value most.

examples.chinese: 我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng tuō le dì, dìshàng háishì shī de, nǐ zuìhǎo rào guòqù bǐjiào ānquán.
examples.english: I just mopped the floor, and the floor is still wet; you'd better go around it, it's safer.

examples.chinese:
弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。
台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin:
Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le.
Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english:
My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m.
Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
examples.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu, yán hé táng, yǐ jiǎnqīng shēntǐ de fùdān.
examples.english: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt, and sugar in order to lighten the body's burden.

examples.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
examples.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
examples.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
examples.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
examples.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

examples.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
examples.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

examples.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
examples.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

items.wordHook: Sleeping off heavy jars of fermented 酉(wine) until dawn morning 星(star) shines helps the drinker 醒(wake up).

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
examples.pinyin: Zài Ōuzhōu, xiǎomài zuò de gè zhǒng shípǐn cháng bèi dàngzuò cānzhuō shàng de zhǔyào shíwù.
examples.english: In Europe, various foods made from wheat are often regarded as the main food on the dining table.

examples.chinese: 她做的籃子很漂亮，很多人買來當作禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de lánzi hěn piàoliang, hěn duō rén mǎi lái dàngzuò lǐwù.
examples.english: The baskets she makes are very pretty; many people buy them as gifts.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
examples.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

examples.chinese: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóngshì mǒu xiàng gōngzuò néng lìng nǐ wàngdiào shíjiān, huòxǔ jiù kě dàngzuò yīshēng de shìyè.
examples.english: If being engaged in a certain job can make you forget time, perhaps it can be treated as a lifelong career.

examples.chinese: 那家中式點心店的紅豆沙包子又香又甜，我時常買來當作早餐。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā zhōngshì diǎnxīn diàn de hóngdòushā bāozi yòu xiāng yòu tián, wǒ shícháng mǎi lái dàngzuò zǎocān.
examples.english: The red bean paste buns at that Chinese dim sum shop are both fragrant and sweet; I often buy them for breakfast.

examples.chinese: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěntou, zhǐhǎo bǎ bēibāo dàngzuò zhěntou, shuì qǐlái tǐng bù shūfu de.
examples.english: When camping, I didn't bring a pillow, so I had to use my backpack as a pillow; sleeping was quite uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
examples.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

examples.chinese: 王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wáng māma yīzhí bǎ xífù dàngzuò zìjǐ de nǚ'ér, dāng tāmen jiā de xífù zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang has always treated her daughter-in-law as her own daughter; being their family's daughter-in-law is truly blessed.

examples.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
examples.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

examples.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
examples.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

examples.chinese: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gègèhánggèyè rénwù dāngzuò tícái de chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: He wants to write a full-length novel that uses people from all walks of life as its subject matter.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 想導演一部以蟲子當作主角的電影，真不是件容易的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng dǎoyǎn yī bù yǐ chóngzi dàngzuò zhǔjiǎo de diànyǐng, zhēn bù shì jiàn róngyì de shì.
examples.english: Wanting to direct a movie with insects as the main characters is really not an easy thing.

examples.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
examples.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

examples.chinese: 食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
examples.pinyin: Shípǐn guàntou chī wán yǐhòu bǎ guànzi xǐ gānjìng, jiù kěyǐ huíshōu le.
examples.english: After you finish eating canned food, wash the can clean, and then it can be recycled.

examples.chinese:
媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。
今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin:
Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le.
Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english:
Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard.
Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 請你把空罐子放在袋子裡，好讓垃圾車一起回收。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ kōng guànzi fàng zài dàizi lǐ, hǎo ràng lājīchē yīqǐ huíshōu.
examples.english: Please put the empty cans in the bag, so that the garbage truck can recycle them together.

examples.chinese: 電腦展內的人太多了，大家擠來擠去的，真是受不了。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo zhǎn nèi de rén tài duō le, dàjiā jǐ lái jǐ qù de, zhēn shì shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: There are too many people inside the computer exhibition; everyone is crowding in and squeezing around—it's really unbearable.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 上下班的時候，捷運站有很多人，總是很擠。
examples.pinyin: Shàngxiàbān de shíhou, jiéyùn zhàn yǒu hěn duō rén, zǒngshì hěn jǐ.
examples.english: During rush hour, there are many people at the MRT station; it's always very crowded.

examples.chinese: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chù fēngjǐngqū fēicháng yǒumíng, jiàrì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóukè.
examples.english: This scenic area is very famous; on holidays it is crowded with tourists.

examples.chinese: 今天搭捷運參加演唱會的民眾很多，車上擠得都不能轉身。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dā jiéyùn cānjiā yǎnchànghuì de mínzhòng hěn duō, chē shàng jǐ de dōu bù néng zhuǎnshēn.
examples.english: There were many people taking the MRT to the concert today; the train was so crowded that you couldn't even turn around.

examples.chinese: 隨著空氣被汙染的情況越來越嚴重，得到癌症的機會也增加了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kōngqì bèi wūrǎn de qíngkuàng yuèláiyuè yánzhòng, dédào áizhèng de jīhuì yě zēngjiā le.
examples.english: As the situation of air pollution becomes more and more serious, the chance of getting cancer has also increased.

items.wordHook: Combining 承(char) and 認(know): 承認 means admit.
a 龵(hand) holds 一(one) 丰(abundant) stalk and bends low to 拜(bow).
Combining 行(walk) and 為(do): 行為 means behavior, conduct.
A 衤(cloth) that 甫(to begin) to tear needs a needle and thread to make it whole again: 補(fix).
To 請(ask) a 教(education): 請教 means ask.
a 亠(lid) covers 从(follow) as a 木(tree) and 隹(bird) crowd together → a 雜(mix).
